verdict.rationale: Neon is open-source Postgres that you reach with any standard Postgres client such as psql or DBeaver, and it can be compiled and run locally. That makes Postgres-native extraction and self-hosting plausible exit paths, and object storage is S3-compatible. However, no evidence documents an actual export or migration-out workflow. Missing for 10: documented full-data export (e.g. pg_dump or logical replication out), export of Auth users/sessions, object storage and function code, and independent hands-on reports of leaving Neon.
